alias-of:beeshterah_171>ashtaroth_106@be.note: Parallel Gershonite lists give Beeshterah (Josh 21:27) and Ashtaroth (1 Chr 6:71) in the same Manasseh slot. The names differ; identity is inferred.

alias-of:chinnereth_294>chinnereth_293@0.note: Both keys are the name Chinnereth. 19:35 names one fenced city; the text does not say two entries are one place.

alias-of:chisloth-tabor_297>chesulloth_2.note: Chislothtabor is a Zebulun border point (19:12); Chesulloth is an Issachar town (19:18). Same place is not stated; the names are close.

alias-of:dimnah_335>rimmon_1005@3095a4.note: Parallel Merari lists of Zebulun towns: Dimnah (Josh 21:35) and Rimmon (1 Chr 6:77) in the same slot. Names differ; identity is inferred.

alias-of:ebron_352>abdon_3@7a632c.note: Ebron (Hebron, 19:28) and Abdon (21:30) are listed as separate towns of Asher. No verse equates them.

alias-of:elteke_377>eltekeh_378@72ba10.note: The text names only Eltekeh, a Dan town (19:44; 21:23). Elteke is a shorter spelling of the same name; identity is inferred.

alias-of:hammoth-dor_520>hammath_518@c62.note: Hammothdor (21:32) and Hammath (19:35) are both Naphtali towns with near-identical names. Identity is inferred, not stated.

alias-of:kanah_667>cana_271@045ced.note: Kanah is an Asher border town (19:28). Identity with the New Testament Cana (John 2:1) is a traditional identification from outside this text.

alias-of:kartah_671>kitron_706@eb9cff.note: Kartah is a Zebulun Levitical town (21:34); Kitron is a Zebulun town (Judg 1:30). Same tribe; identity is inferred from outside.

alias-of:kattath_673>kitron_706@016559.note: Kattath is a Zebulun town (19:15); Kitron is a Zebulun town (Judg 1:30). Same tribe and similar name; identity is inferred, not stated.

alias-of:leshem_727>dan_323@67ecb6.note: The Danites took Leshem and called it Dan after their father (19:47).

alias-of:rakkath_970>tiberias_1161@69fbe.note: Rakkath is a Naphtali fenced city (19:35). Tiberias is not in this text; the identification comes from outside Scripture.

alias-of:remeth_994>ramoth_981@825685.note: Remeth is an Issachar town (19:21); Ramoth is an Issachar town in the parallel list (1 Chr 6:73). Names differ; identity is inferred.

alias-of:shaalabbin_1052>shaalbim_1053@8.note: Shaalabbin is a Dan town (19:42); Shaalbim is named near Aijalon (Judg 1:35). Spelling differs; identity is inferred, not stated.

alias-of:sidon_1094>sidon_1093@efa83d.note: The text says great Zidon (19:28), spelled differently. Sidon the Great and Sidon are the same city only by spelling and epithet.

alias-of:timnath-serah_1167>timnath-here.note: Judg 2:9 gives Joshua's burial in the same words as Josh 24:30 but spells the town Timnathheres. A parallel with a different spelling, so a reading.

date:death-of-joshua@1ff2b6.note: The text gives only timing: after these things, at age 110 (24:29). The year depends on dating outside Scripture; -1423 is 1424 BC.

member-of:simeon_2743>tribe-of-judah@c01.note: Simeon is a separate tribe whose inheritance lay within Judah's portion (19:1, 19:9). It is not a group within Judah.

occurred-at:death-of-joshua>timnath-sera.note: The text says Joshua was buried in Timnathserah (24:30). It does not say where he died.

part-of:adami-nekeb_23>naphtali_1284@1a4.note: Named in Naphtali's allotment as Adami, Nekeb (19:33); the section closes with nineteen cities (19:38).

part-of:allammelech_47>asher_1287@439414.note: Asher's allotment names Alammelech (19:26), a spelling variant. Within Asher follows from the tribe's list.

part-of:aznoth-tabor_131>naphtali_1284@d.note: Named as a point on Naphtali's border (19:34), within the tribe's allotment (closes with nineteen cities, 19:38).

part-of:baalath-beer_138>judah_1280@7f0b.note: Baalathbeer is the outer limit of Simeon's villages (19:8). Simeon's inheritance lay within Judah's (19:9). Inside the tribe is inferred.

part-of:bene-berak_173>dan_1283@68f3f8.note: Beneberak is named in Dan's allotment (19:45).

part-of:beth-anath_184>naphtali_1284@08e.note: Bethanath is named in Naphtali's allotment (19:38).

part-of:beth-dagon_198>asher_1287@87fbbf.note: Bethdagon is named in Asher's border description (19:27), within the tribe's allotment.

part-of:beth-emek_204>asher_1287@fb5a1e.note: Bethemek appears only as a landmark for the border (north side of Bethemek, 19:27), not as an Asherite town. Inside Asher is inferred.

part-of:beth-pazzez_226>issachar_1288@14.note: Bethpazzez is named in Issachar's list (19:21).

part-of:beth-shemesh_235>issachar_1288@7.note: Bethshemesh is named among Issachar's towns (19:22).

part-of:beth-shemesh_236>naphtali_1284@a.note: Bethshemesh is named in Naphtali's allotment (19:38). The same name recurs for Issachar (19:22) and Judah (21:16).

part-of:dabbesheth_318>zebulun_1289@d98e.note: Zebulun's border passes Dabbasheth (19:11), a different spelling. Within Zebulun follows from the tribe's allotment.

part-of:dan_1283>united-kingdom-of-israe.note: Dan is one of the tribes of the children of Israel (19:51). The kingdom and its name are outside labels; the text names no kingdom.

part-of:ebez_351>issachar_1288@1c3354.note: Issachar's list has Abez (19:20), a spelling variant. Within Issachar follows from the list.

part-of:en-gannim_388>issachar_1288@f2bd.note: Engannim is in Issachar's list (19:21) and is a Levitical city out of Issachar (21:29).

part-of:en-haddah_390>issachar_1288@e86e.note: Enhaddah is named in Issachar's list (19:21).

part-of:en-hazor_392>naphtali_1284@44551.note: Enhazor is named in Naphtali's list (19:37).

part-of:eth-kazin_420>zebulun_1289@b3965.note: Zebulun's border passes Ittahkazin (19:13), a different spelling. Within Zebulun follows from the tribe's allotment.

part-of:gath-hepher_443>zebulun_1289@ae7.note: Zebulun's border passes Gittahhepher (19:13), a different spelling. Within Zebulun follows from the tribe's allotment.

part-of:gath-rimmon_444>dan_1283@af2541.note: Gathrimmon is named in Dan's allotment (19:45) and among Dan's Levitical cities (21:24).

part-of:ithlah_602>dan_1283@c92781.note: Dan's list has Jethlah (19:42), a spelling variant. Within Dan follows from the list.

part-of:lakkum_715>naphtali_1284@dbd64b.note: Naphtali's border reaches Lakum (19:33), a spelling variant. Within Naphtali follows from the tribe's allotment.

part-of:mareal_766>zebulun_1289@974b8d.note: Zebulun's border goes by Maralah (19:11), a spelling variant. Within Zebulun follows from the tribe's allotment.

part-of:migdal-el_797>naphtali_1284@9574.note: Migdalel is named in Naphtali's allotment (19:38).

part-of:shahazumah_1057>issachar_1288@be.note: Issachar's list has Shahazimah (19:22), a spelling variant. Within Issachar follows from the list.

part-of:yiron_1233>naphtali_1284@acf71e.note: Naphtali's list has Iron (19:38), a spelling variant. Within Naphtali follows from the list.
